keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 5 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 15 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

themes.name: LLM coding and orchestration agents
themes.summary: The papers examine LLM-based coding agents and the orchestration frameworks that coordinate them across software engineering work such as code generation, repository setup, migration, review, testing, and web/game development. Some contributions build benchmarks, verified training data, and verification or self-evaluation methods, while others propose multi-agent orchestration architectures, agent harnesses, and studies of developer delegation and tool interfaces. They differ in whether they focus on agent capability and evaluation, on orchestration and workflow synthesis, or on human/organizational adoption in regulated and industrial settings.

themes.name: Vision-language-action robot control
themes.summary: The papers build and improve Vision-Language-Action models for robot control, focusing on efficient inference through ultra-low-bit quantization and spiking/event-driven execution, learning from teacher or egocentric human data, and long-horizon memory and recursive policy refinement. They differ in whether they address representation learning or deployment hardware, and several also contribute robot platforms or benchmarks for evaluation. Collectively they span manipulation, legged/humanoid locomotion, and multi-finger hand control.

themes.name: Embodied world models and navigation
themes.summary: These papers build embodied world models and navigation systems: controllable video world models for camera, action, and multi-agent simulation; benchmarks that test whether world models capture physical coherence and policy failure; spatial memory and positional representations for embodied reasoning; and navigation stacks spanning visual SLAM, control-barrier and sampling-based planners, language-guided and schematic-guided navigation, and human trajectory prediction. They differ in whether they generate and evaluate predictive worlds, learn spatial representations from video and scans, or deploy perception-and-planning policies on robots in congested, dynamic, or previously unseen environments.

themes.name: Medical imaging foundation and multimodal models
themes.summary: The papers advance medical foundation and multimodal models across imaging domains, including pathology foundation model latent-space analysis, retinal OCT representation learning and model compression, and metadata-conditioned vision–language pretraining. Several works build agentic and multimodal reasoning systems, such as natural-language pathology workflows, chest CT report grounding, and surgical vision–language datasets, while others target efficient or robust clinical models for segmentation, classification, and image translation. They differ in modality, task, and approach, ranging from foundation-model studies and lightweight distillation to multi-agent routing and annotation-driven multimodal understanding.

themes.name: LLM agent memory and context management
themes.summary: The papers examine how LLM agents compress, store, retrieve, and self-manage context and long-term memory across dialogue, multimodal, embodied, and multi-agent settings. They differ in whether they focus on context compression, salience-gated or budget-adaptive memory, counterfactual probing and benchmarks, reusable experience, or self-controlled context management.

themes.name: LLM agent safety and security
themes.summary: These papers study safety and security risks that arise when language-model agents act with tools, memory, delegation and multi-agent coordination, covering collusion and strategic deception, false-belief spread through agent networks, conflicting instructions, unclear responsibility boundaries, unverifiable tool identity, misinformation susceptibility, unauthorized side effects, and adversarial manipulation such as poisoned source code or synthetic social engineering. They differ in approach: some contribute benchmarks and evaluation frameworks that score behavior rather than task success, others propose mitigation mechanisms such as on-policy distillation, deterministic hardware-rooted runtimes, probe-based identity checks and calibrated-trust or persuasion rewards, and still others model how risk, hallucination and influence propagate across agent societies.

themes.name: Uncertainty quantification and calibrated prediction
themes.summary: The papers develop calibration and uncertainty-quantification methods so that model outputs carry reliable, error-controlled confidence across domains such as gene-function annotation, multi-agent LLM reasoning, vision classifiers, cerebral-perfusion digital twins, finance, click-through-rate recalibration, autonomous driving, content moderation, label auditing, out-of-distribution detection, and decision-making under distribution shift. Approaches range from conformal prediction and confidence sequences with coverage or certification guarantees, to abstention and gain-gated adaptation, latent-force ODE filtering, and representation-based reliability detectors, plus a survey. They differ in whether they pursue guaranteed finite-sample error control, empirical detection of confident failures, or calibrated decision thresholds and abstention.

themes.name: Causal inference and counterfactual evaluation
themes.summary: The papers develop causal and counterfactual methods for learning, testing, and evaluating models and policies across domains. They differ by focusing on causal discovery repair and partial identification, counterfactual editing and testing in neural and language models, or off-policy and treatment-effect estimation for decisions and longitudinal data.

themes.name: Recursive self-improvement for LLM agents
themes.summary: These papers study LLM agents that improve themselves from their own execution experience, whether by adapting harnesses and skill documents, writing lessons from run outcomes, evolving skills across multiple agents, or running evolutionary search toward recursive self-improvement. Several works examine the pitfalls of such loops, showing that harness benefits vary with model capability and that lessons drawn from noisy outcomes can carry chance into later decisions. Others build full self-improvement pipelines in which agents design, train, and evaluate successor models with human feedback or across domains, and benchmark long-horizon continual learning; they differ in whether improvement flows through skill artifacts, training-time post-training loops, or evaluation frameworks.

themes.name: LLM benchmark validity and evaluation artifacts
themes.summary: The papers examine whether automated evaluations—LLM judges, benchmarks, rubrics, and expert-grounded protocols—actually measure the intended construct, and they probe artifacts such as judge version changes, semantic inconsistency, conformance definitions, data leakage, non-comparable hallucination benchmarks, and prompt or log effects. They differ by focusing on auditing benchmark validity and leakage, formalizing consistency or conformance, distilling expert judgment into scalable evaluations, or building domain-specific and rubric-based evaluation batteries.

themes.name: Neural operators and physics-informed learning
themes.summary: The papers develop physics-informed neural networks and neural-operator surrogates for solving and accelerating differential-equation models across fluid, semiconductor, chemical, energy, and radiative systems. They differ in architecture and training emphasis, including discontinuity-aware hybrid-time PINNs, geometry-aware and multi-resolution operator designs, graph-based solvers, spectral bases, benchmark evaluation, and kernel-theoretic analysis.

themes.name: Time-series forecasting and foundation models
themes.summary: The papers study time-series forecasting and foundation models by assessing predictability and attribution, benchmarking decision-oriented models, and improving forecasting via super-resolution, expert specialization, transfer learning, decoding, and graph construction. They differ in whether they evaluate or explain models, adapt classical or foundation-model approaches, or target domain-specific forecasting such as aerosols and battery life.

highlights.title: Build, Don't Play: Self-Improving LLM Research Agents Develop a Hearthstone Battlegrounds AI That Rivals Top Players
highlights.why: Demonstrates a self-improving agent system that builds a Hearthstone AI rivaling top players from raw data, a compelling, verifiable leap in autonomous research.
highlights.key_result: In 20 days AutoTavern built TavernGym, the first faithful, full-content reproduction of the live game, and delivered 23 versions of TavernAgent; TavernAgent plays complete games on the live ladder by itself, its rating rose from 6,000 to about 15,000, and its last 20 records average a placement of 1.60 with 80% first places, better than the server's ten highest-rated players on every statistic (2.34, 59%).

highlights.why: Introduces a large-scale dataset and framework that addresses coupled camera-trajectory and character-consistency challenges, making it a strong addition for world-consistent video generation.
highlights.key_result: WorldCast achieves superior camera control and character consistency while maintaining competitive visual quality, with gains spanning trajectory accuracy, cross-view geometry, and identity and appearance preservation.

Experiments on both synthetic and real-world scenes demonstrate more accurate camera control and stronger preservation of character geometry, appearance, and identity, while maintaining competitive visual quality.

highlights.title: Continual Learning Exam: Benchmarking Long-Horizon RSI and Experiential Learning in LLM Agents
highlights.authors: Haoyu Zhao, Sitian Tu, Yuxuan Huang et al.
highlights.why: A large expert-built benchmark with 600 levels provides a much-needed rigorous testbed for experience-driven improvement, though its current gains are modest.
highlights.key_result: Across 17 harness--model configurations using frontier LLMs, feedback and revision yield a median completion gain of 5.3 percentage points. Yet the best-performing system clears only 47.7% of levels and completes all five levels in just 23.3% of tasks, highlighting the difficulty of sustained learning from experience for existing frontier LLMs.

highlights.title: Learning Dexterous Manipulation: Hands, Simulators, Training, and Evaluation
highlights.why: Comprehensive survey of 113 methods with code/vendor checks reveals a dominant RL-to-vision recipe and overlooked hardware, making it a useful field reference.
highlights.key_result: This survey covers 113 learning-based methods for dexterous manipulation, and finds the field has largely converged on one recipe: reinforcement learning on privileged state in a GPU simulator, distilled into a vision-only student. Fifty-four of the 113 method papers train this way, most in one simulator, and four hands carry almost every experiment, led by the Allegro at 35 of the 113 papers.

Both branches run on remarkably little hardware. Four hands carry almost every experiment in this corpus, led by the Allegro at 35 of the 113 papers; gives the rest of the distribution.

highlights.title: RoboJev: An Open Vision-Language Judge for Robot Success Detection
highlights.why: An open-weight judge for robot success detection fills a practical gap and demonstrates strong cross-lab generalization, likely to be widely adopted.
highlights.key_result: RoboJev-27B attains 95.2% balanced accuracy and 0.993 AUROC on 268 held-out SO-101 episodes; it generalises to unseen labs/robots (AUROC = 0.890 over 459 episodes) and clearly labelled community-collected episodes (accuracy = 93.3% over 135 episodes), while the base model attains AUROC = 0.900 on the unseen-lab/robot subset.

highlights.title: How Do Small Coding Agents Use Code Graphs and Embeddings?
highlights.why: Large-scale ablation with 79k episodes provides counterintuitive evidence that tool benefits peak at small scales and diminish with capacity, which should inform agent design.
highlights.key_result: The paper shows that each extra code-graph hop roughly halves the odds of correct function-level localization for four models from 4B to 32B after controls and at every one of six sizes from 0.6B to 32B; structured tools roughly double grep-only accuracy for Qwen3-8B and Gemma 4 E4B, with their gain peaking at 17--21 points at 1.7--4B and falling to 4--5 at 32B as the model stops calling them, while graph tools provide exact-name lookup at hop 0 and one expansion at hop 1 and do not flatten the depth gradient. A fixed repair model turns those localizations into 6--13 resolved tasks of 160 against 26 with oracle locations, and linear probes find a direct-call representation that is weaker than a substring test and does not extend to two hops or to inheritance.
evidence: We labelled SWE-bench Verified with a deterministic code-graph hop depth, showed that each hop roughly halves the odds of correct function-level localization for four models from 4B to 32B after controls and at every one of six sizes from 0.6B to 32B, and released the labels.

We ablated the tool set of a localization agent and found that structured tools roughly double grep-only accuracy for Qwen3-8B and Gemma 4 E4B, that only graph tools help Qwen3-4B, that over a scale curve from 0.6B to 32B the tools' gain peaks at 17--21 points at 1.7--4B and falls to 4--5 at 32B as the model stops calling them (with about half of the gain from 8B up being the form of the submission), that the same size gains or does not gain from a tool depending on the checkpoint, and that the graph tools' benefit is exact-name lookup at hop 0 and one expansion at hop 1---they do not flatten the depth gradient, and forcing their use, enlarging the budget or sampling does not change that.

A fixed repair model turns those localizations into 6--13 resolved tasks of 160 against 26 with oracle locations, almost all of them on correctly localized tasks. Linear probes, once stratified to remove node-level confounds, find a direct-call representation in the middle layers that transfers across repositories and survives inside agent conversations, but that is weaker than a substring test and does not extend to two hops or to inheritance.

highlights.title: Task Success Is Not Enough: Side-effect-Aware Evaluation of Tool-Using Language Model Agents
highlights.authors: Jiaju Huang, Shaobin Chen, Xinglong Liang et al.
highlights.why: Introduces a benchmark for unauthorized side effects and shows 15% of runs incur collateral damage, highlighting a critical missing metric.

news.title: Greptile takes bug detection beyond code review with GPT-6 Astra
news.summary: Greptile uses GPT-6 Astra's computer use to test applications at scale, for example by resizing a browser to an iPhone-sized viewport to catch a button that disappears; it also connects Codex to its Knowledge Base via an MCP server, which thousands of customers have used, and uses Daybreak for security. CEO Daksh Gupta says the team tracks how often AI-generated code is reverted as a measure of the value of giving agents context.

news.title: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding
news.summary: OpenAI announced three new results in mathematics, computer science, and physics and used three different release strategies advised by external expert shepherds: releasing the math output as-is, forming an external group to explain the computer science result while publishing the output, and deferring to a physics group that chose to withhold AI artifacts while writing the result up. The computer science group published the natural language proof and Lean formalization immediately to OpenAI's GitHub repository, and the collaborations follow four principles: transparency, no academic credit, recognition, and independence.

news.title: GPT-6.1 Sol helps CodeRabbit strengthen security across complex codebases
news.summary: CodeRabbit uses GPT-6.1 Sol as the primary model in its security agent, analyzing pull requests across files and components, with Deep Scan covering dependencies and CodeRabbit Secure extending investigation to linked repositories such as a shared authentication library. For user-selected findings it can attempt exploit verification in an isolated sandbox and draft a pull request with a proposed fix for human review; CodeRabbit reports flagging security issues across thousands of repositories and organizations.

news.title: ChatGPT’s expanding world of work
news.summary: OpenAI Economic Research released OpenAI Signals data covering 165 work activities across nearly 100 countries, mapped to Intermediate Work Activities based on O*NET and reported quarterly from Q1 2025 through Q3 2026. Across 74 countries observed every quarter, the ten most common activities averaged 51.1% of each country's classified work messages in Q3 2026, down from 56.0% in Q1 2025; the data covers individual ChatGPT plans and excludes enterprise messages and Codex use.

news.title: Our newest AI Quest: Mapping the human brain
news.summary: Google Research and the Stanford Accelerator for Learning launched "Polar Peaks," the third quest in the AI Quests series, teaching students ages 11 to 14 to map neurons using AI via tasks including data cleaning and model testing, inspired by connectomics research including the mapping of the complete fruit fly brain. More than 400,000 quests have been completed to date, localized to 10 languages, and teacher training modules launch in the Google AI Educator Series with the module for Quest #3 following next month; the program won a 2026 Webby Award for AI Education, Learning & Training and a Best Global K-12 Learning Solution award at the ETIH Innovation Awards.

news.title: How NVIDIA Minerva Turns Telemetry Chaos Into Peak GPU Yield
news.summary: NVIDIA Minerva is an AI-native AIOps platform that unifies telemetry across GPUs, networking, storage, and workloads into a dynamic knowledge graph mapping infrastructure to active jobs, using supervised and unsupervised models to detect gray failures such as one degraded NVLink interface among 400,000 or a GPU running hotter than peers under identical load. Topology-aware correlation grouped 81 alerts from a pause-frame storm into one incident, saving an estimated 54 hours of cluster uptime, and an AI agent named Sherlock plus an MCP server let operators query live evidence in natural language.

news.title: How NVIDIA Mission Control 2.5 Brings Autonomous Recovery to Kubernetes
news.summary: NVIDIA Mission Control 2.5 extends its autonomous recovery engine, previously limited to HPC workloads on Slurm, to Kubernetes-based workloads managed by NVIDIA Run:ai. The engine works as a three-layer control loop in which the scheduler places workloads, a job recovery service classifies failures using job context, and a hardware recovery service quarantines and diagnoses faulty nodes in parallel, retrying transient software errors without hardware remediation and removing degrading nodes from the scheduling pool early.

news.title: Fleet-wide computer vision lifecycle at the edge with SageMaker SDK v3
news.summary: This AWS post updates a 2023 visual quality inspection MLOps pattern to SageMaker Python SDK v3, replacing the deprecated SageMaker Edge Manager with SageMaker Neo, using a per-camera SageMaker Pipeline of 13 steps that trains a convolutional autoencoder anomaly detector and a ResNet18 defect classifier with quality gates before Neo compilation and Model Registry registration. A Step Functions and SQS FIFO orchestration layer paces fleet training through a DynamoDB semaphore, and a full pipeline run on synthetic data costs about $0.07 in compute.

news.title: Groundhog Day for AI agents: Prompt caching patterns for using OpenAI models on Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: The post explains prompt caching for agents using OpenAI models on Amazon Bedrock: the service stores the prefilled prompt state (tools, instructions, history) and reuses it, charging full price only for new tokens, whereas an uncached agent by turn 20 re-reads turns 1-19. Caching can be implicit, with Bedrock choosing where the reusable prefix ends, or explicit via prompt_cache_breakpoint, and the post recommends combining both.

news.title: Build agentic retrieval on a Managed Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base with CDK
news.summary: The post builds agentic retrieval on a Managed Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base with the AWS CDK, replacing a single-shot RAG design from an August 2024 post; the MANAGED knowledge base owns ingestion, storage, indexing, and retrieval, removing the OpenSearch Serverless collection and OCU costs. An agent routes across two knowledge bases through an AgentCore Gateway exposing each as an MCP tool and uses AgenticRetrieveStream, which reranks and returns a cited answer; the deployment includes two CloudWatch dashboards spanning seven layers of telemetry and on-demand and continuous evaluation.

keywords.about: 扩散和流匹配被训练用于芯片布局、网格上的物理场和图像合成。

themes.name: LLM编码与编排智能体
themes.summary: 这些论文研究基于LLM的编码智能体以及协调它们的编排框架，涵盖代码生成、仓库设置、迁移、审查、测试以及网页/游戏开发等软件工程工作。一些贡献构建基准、经过验证的训练数据以及验证或自评估方法，而另一些提出多智能体编排架构、智能体harness以及对开发者委托和工具界面的研究。它们的区别在于关注智能体能力与评估、编排与工作流合成，还是受监管和工业环境中的人/组织采用。

themes.name: 视觉-语言-动作机器人控制
themes.summary: 这些论文构建并改进用于机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作模型，重点包括通过超低位量化、脉冲/事件驱动执行实现高效推理，从教师或以自我为中心的人类数据中学习，以及长时程记忆和递归策略细化。它们的区别在于解决表示学习还是部署硬件，其中一些还贡献了机器人平台或评估基准。总体上涵盖操作、腿式/人形运动和灵巧手控制。

themes.name: 具身世界模型与导航
themes.summary: 这些论文构建具身世界模型和导航系统：用于相机、动作和多智能体模拟的可控视频世界模型；测试世界模型是否捕捉物理一致性和策略失败的基准；用于具身推理的空间记忆和位置表示；以及涵盖视觉SLAM、控制屏障和基于采样的规划器、语言引导和示意图引导导航以及人类轨迹预测的导航栈。它们的区别在于生成和评估预测世界，从视频和扫描中学习空间表示，还是在拥堵、动态或先前未见环境中部署感知与规划策略。

themes.name: 医学影像基础与多模态模型
themes.summary: 这些论文推进跨影像领域的医学基础和多模态模型，包括病理学基础模型的潜在空间分析、视网膜OCT表示学习和模型压缩，以及元数据条件下的视觉-语言预训练。一些工作构建智能体和多模态推理系统，例如自然语言病理工作流、胸部CT报告接地和手术视觉-语言数据集，而另一些则针对分割、分类和图像翻译的高效或鲁棒临床模型。它们在模态、任务和方法上有所不同，从基础模型研究和轻量蒸馏到多智能体路由和注释驱动的多模态理解。

themes.name: LLM智能体记忆与上下文管理
themes.summary: 这些论文研究LLM智能体如何在对话、多模态、具身和多智能体环境中压缩、存储、检索和自我管理上下文及长期记忆。它们的区别在于关注上下文压缩、显著性门控或预算自适应记忆、反事实探测与基准、可重用经验，还是自控式上下文管理。

themes.name: LLM智能体安全与安保
themes.summary: 这些论文研究当语言模型智能体使用工具、记忆、委派和多智能体协调时出现的安全与安保风险，涵盖串谋与策略性欺骗、虚假信念通过智能体网络传播、指令冲突、责任边界不清、不可验证的工具身份、易受错误信息影响、未经授权的副作用，以及诸如中毒源代码或合成社会工程等对抗性操纵。它们在方法上有所不同：一些贡献对行为而非任务成功进行评分的基准和评估框架，另一些提出缓解机制，如在线策略蒸馏、确定性硬件根运行时、基于探针的身份检查以及经过校准的信任或说服奖励，还有一些模型化风险、幻觉和影响如何在智能体社会中传播。

themes.name: 不确定性量化与校准预测
themes.summary: 这些论文开发校准和不确定性量化方法，使模型输出在基因功能注释、多智能体LLM推理、视觉分类器、脑灌注数字孪生、金融、点击率重校准、自动驾驶、内容审核、标签审计、分布外检测以及分布偏移下的决策等领域具有可靠、误差可控的置信度。方法范围从具有覆盖或认证保证的共形预测和置信序列，到弃权和增益门控自适应、潜在力ODE滤波以及基于表示的可靠性检测器，还包括一篇综述。它们的区别在于追求有保证的有限样本误差控制、对高置信失败的经验检测，还是校准决策阈值和弃权。

themes.name: 因果推断与反事实评估
themes.summary: 这些论文开发因果和反事实方法，用于跨领域学习、测试和评估模型与策略。它们的区别在于关注因果发现修复与部分识别、神经和语言模型中的反事实编辑和测试，还是用于决策和纵向数据的离策略及处理效应估计。

themes.name: LLM智能体的递归自我改进
themes.summary: 这些论文研究LLM智能体如何从自身执行经验中自我改进，无论是通过调整harness和技能文档、从运行结果中总结经验、在多个智能体间进化技能，还是运行进化搜索以实现递归自我改进。一些工作考察此类循环的陷阱，表明harness的收益随模型能力而异，并且从噪声结果中得出的经验可能将偶然性带入后续决策。另一些构建完整的自我改进流水线，其中智能体设计、训练并评估后继模型，结合人类反馈或跨领域，并对长时程持续学习进行基准测试；它们的区别在于改进是通过技能制品、训练时的后训练循环还是评估框架来实现。

themes.name: LLM基准效度与评估伪影
themes.summary: 这些论文研究自动化评估——LLM评判器、基准、评分标准和专家锚定协议——是否真正测量了目标构念，并探究诸如评判器版本变化、语义不一致、一致性定义、数据泄漏、不可比较的幻觉基准以及提示或日志效应等伪影。它们的区别在于关注审计基准效度与泄漏，形式化一致性或符合性，将专家判断蒸馏为可扩展的评估，还是构建领域特定和基于评分标准的评估套件。

themes.name: 神经算子与物理信息学习
themes.summary: 这些论文开发物理信息神经网络和神经算子代理，用于求解和加速流体、半导体、化学、能源和辐射系统中的微分方程模型。它们在架构和训练重点上有所不同，包括间断感知的混合时间PINN、几何感知和多分辨率算子设计、基于图的求解器、谱基、基准评估以及核理论分析。

themes.name: 时间序列预测与基础模型
themes.summary: 这些论文通过评估可预测性和归因、对决策导向模型进行基准测试，以及通过超分辨率、专家专业化、迁移学习、解码和图构建改进预测，来研究时间序列预测和基础模型。它们的区别在于评估还是解释模型、采用经典还是基础模型方法，或是针对气溶胶和电池寿命等特定领域的预测。

highlights.title: Build, Don't Play: Self-Improving LLM Research Agents Develop a Hearthstone Battlegrounds AI That Rivals Top Players
highlights.why: 展示了一个自我改进的智能体系统，该系统从原始数据构建出可与顶尖玩家匹敌的《炉石传说》AI，这是自主研究中一个引人注目且可验证的飞跃。
highlights.key_result: 在20天内，AutoTavern构建了TavernGym，这是对实时游戏的首个忠实、全内容复现，并交付了23个版本的TavernAgent；TavernAgent在实时天梯上自行打完完整对局，其评分从6,000升至约15,000，最后20条记录平均排名1.60，80%为第一名，在每项统计上均优于服务器排名前十的玩家（2.34，59%）。
evidence: In 20 days AutoTavern built TavernGym , the first faithful, full-content reproduction of the live game, and delivered 23 versions of TavernAgent , trained with PPO against opponents calibrated to real games.

TavernAgent plays complete games on the live ladder by itself: its rating rose from 6,000 to about 15,000 and, on the public leaderboard's measure, its last 20 records average a placement of 1.60 with 80% first places, better than the server's ten highest-rated players on every statistic (2.34, 59%).

highlights.title: WorldCast: World-Consistent Character Video Generation with Large-Angle Camera Control
highlights.authors: Lei Cao, Yu Liu, Wenhua Liao et al.
highlights.why: 引入了一个大规模数据集和框架，解决相机轨迹与角色一致性相互耦合的挑战，为世界一致的视频生成提供了有力补充。
highlights.key_result: WorldCast在保持有竞争力的视觉质量的同时，实现了更优的相机控制和角色一致性，在轨迹精度、跨视角几何以及身份和外观保持方面均有提升。
evidence: As shown in tab:main, WorldCast achieves superior camera control and character consistency while maintaining competitive visual quality. The gains span trajectory accuracy, cross-view geometry, and identity and appearance preservation.

Experiments on both synthetic and real-world scenes demonstrate more accurate camera control and stronger preservation of character geometry, appearance, and identity, while maintaining competitive visual quality.

highlights.title: Continual Learning Exam: Benchmarking Long-Horizon RSI and Experiential Learning in LLM Agents
highlights.authors: Haoyu Zhao, Sitian Tu, Yuxuan Huang et al.
highlights.why: 一个包含600个关卡的大规模专家构建基准为经验驱动的改进提供了急需的严格测试平台，尽管其当前增益有限。
highlights.key_result: 在使用前沿LLM的17个harness--model配置中，反馈和修订带来了5.3个百分点的中位完成率提升。然而，表现最佳的系统仅通过47.7%的关卡，并且在仅23.3%的任务中完成全部五个关卡，突显了现有前沿LLM从经验中持续学习的难度。
evidence: Across 17 harness--model configurations using frontier LLMs, feedback and revision yield a median completion gain of 5.3 percentage points.

Yet the best-performing system clears only 47.7% of levels and completes all five levels in just 23.3% of tasks, highlighting the difficulty of sustained learning from experience for existing frontier LLMs.

highlights.title: Learning Dexterous Manipulation: Hands, Simulators, Training, and Evaluation
highlights.why: 对113种方法进行的全面综述，包括代码/供应商核查，揭示了占主导地位的RL到视觉的配方和被忽视的硬件，使其成为有用的领域参考文献。
highlights.key_result: This survey covers 113 learning-based methods for dexterous manipulation, and finds the field has largely converged on one recipe: reinforcement learning on privileged state in a GPU simulator, distilled into a vision-only student. Fifty-four of the 113 method papers train this way, most in one simulator, and four hands carry almost every experiment, led by the Allegro at 35 of the 113 papers.
evidence: This survey covers 113 learning-based methods that attempt it, the hands they run on, the simulators they train in, and how they report results.
Fifty-four of the 113 method papers here train this way, most of them in one simulator, and about half of those add the distillation stage.
Both branches run on remarkably little hardware. Four hands carry almost every experiment in this corpus, led by the Allegro at 35 of the 113 papers; gives the rest of the distribution.

highlights.title: RoboJev: An Open Vision-Language Judge for Robot Success Detection
highlights.why: 一个用于机器人成功检测的开放权重评判器填补了实际空白，并表现出强大的跨实验室泛化能力，很可能被广泛采用。
highlights.key_result: RoboJev-27B在268个留出的SO-101片段上达到了95.2%的平衡准确率和0.993 AUROC；它泛化到未见过的实验室/机器人（在459个片段上AUROC = 0.890）以及清晰标注的社区收集片段（在135个片段上准确率 = 93.3%），而基础模型在未见实验室/机器人子集上达到AUROC = 0.900。
evidence: On 268 held-out episodes of the same robot model (SO-101), RoboJev-27B attains 95.2% balanced accuracy and 0.993 AUROC.

It also generalises to episodes collected by unseen labs/robots (AUROC = 0.890 over 459 episodes) as well as to clearly labelled community-collected episodes (accuracy = 93.3% over 135 episodes), where the base model attains an AUROC = 0.900 on the unseen-lab/robot subset with the same inputs.

highlights.title: How Do Small Coding Agents Use Code Graphs and Embeddings?
highlights.why: 使用79k个片段进行的大规模消融提供了反直觉的证据，即工具收益在小规模时达到峰值，并随着能力增强而减弱，这应该为智能体设计提供参考。
highlights.key_result: 论文表明，每增加一个代码图跳数，对于4B到32B的四个模型，在控制变量后以及在0.6B到32B的六个规模中的每一个上，正确函数级定位的几率大约减半；结构化工具对于Qwen3-8B和Gemma 4 E4B，将仅使用grep的准确率大约翻倍，其增益在1.7--4B时达到峰值17--21个百分点，在32B时降至4--5，因为模型不再调用它们；而图工具在hop 0提供精确名称查找，在hop 1提供一次扩展，并且不会使深度梯度变平。一个固定的修复模型将这些定位转化为160个任务中的6--13个已解决任务，而使用oracle位置时为26个，线性探针发现一种直接调用表示，它比子串测试更弱，并且不能扩展到两跳或继承。
evidence: We labelled SWE-bench Verified with a deterministic code-graph hop depth, showed that each hop roughly halves the odds of correct function-level localization for four models from 4B to 32B after controls and at every one of six sizes from 0.6B to 32B, and released the labels.

We ablated the tool set of a localization agent and found that structured tools roughly double grep-only accuracy for Qwen3-8B and Gemma 4 E4B, that only graph tools help Qwen3-4B, that over a scale curve from 0.6B to 32B the tools' gain peaks at 17--21 points at 1.7--4B and falls to 4--5 at 32B as the model stops calling them (with about half of the gain from 8B up being the form of the submission), that the same size gains or does not gain from a tool depending on the checkpoint, and that the graph tools' benefit is exact-name lookup at hop 0 and one expansion at hop 1---they do not flatten the depth gradient, and forcing their use, enlarging the budget or sampling does not change that.

A fixed repair model turns those localizations into 6--13 resolved tasks of 160 against 26 with oracle locations, almost all of them on correctly localized tasks. Linear probes, once stratified to remove node-level confounds, find a direct-call representation in the middle layers that transfers across repositories and survives inside agent conversations, but that is weaker than a substring test and does not extend to two hops or to inheritance.

highlights.title: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory
highlights.authors: Xuan He, Sining Zhoubian, Ruozhen Yang et al.
highlights.theme: LLM agent memory and context management
highlights.why: 大规模评估发现许多记忆系统表现不如朴素RAG，并剖析了损失，为记忆研究提供了有价值的现实检验。
highlights.key_result: 通过在多个基准和模型骨干上进行的大规模评估，论文发现“许多专用记忆系统在许多情况下表现不如朴素RAG，表明净价值为负。”在三个基准上，“许多记忆方法表现不如朴素RAG，表明在这些设置中净价值为负。”
evidence: Through a large-scale evaluation across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, we find many dedicated memory systems underperform naive RAG in many cases, indicating a negative net value.
The results show that naive RAG remains a strong baseline and many memory systems underperform it across diverse settings, indicating a negative net value in these cases.

Across the evaluation on three benchmarks with many retrieval-friendly queries alongside some complex ones, many memory methods underperform naive RAG, indicating a negative net value in these settings.

highlights.title: Task Success Is Not Enough: Side-effect-Aware Evaluation of Tool-Using Language Model Agents
highlights.authors: Jiaju Huang, Shaobin Chen, Xinglong Liang et al.
highlights.why: 引入了一个针对未经授权副作用的基准，并显示15%的运行发生附带损害，突出了一个关键的缺失指标。
highlights.key_result: 论文引入了SABench，一个包含201个任务、具有确定性oracle的基准，并在2,211个模型-任务对上评估了11个前沿LLM。结果显示，所有运行中有15.2%发生附带损害，满足目标的运行中有12.8%仍然产生未经授权的写入，风险集中在歧义任务中（违规率38.8%），而非歧义陷阱的平均CD为8.4%。
evidence: Second, we release SABench, a 201-task / 47-template benchmark with a deterministic oracle for goal, CD, ambiguity, and visibility (Section ). Third, we evaluate 11 frontier LLMs on 2,211 model--task pairs: 15.2% of all runs and 12.8% of goal-satisfied runs incur CD, with strong variation by model, trap family, and state structure (Section ).

Across 2,211 model-task pairs from 11 frontier LLMs spanning major commercial and open model families, 15.2% of all runs incur CD, with risk concentrated in ambiguity tasks (38.8% violation rate) while non-ambiguous traps average 8.4% CD. Among goal-satisfied runs, 12.8% still produce unauthorized writes.

news.title: Greptile takes bug detection beyond code review with GPT-6 Astra
news.summary: Greptile使用GPT-6 Astra的计算机使用能力大规模测试应用程序，例如将浏览器调整为iPhone大小的视口，以捕捉消失的按钮；它还通过MCP服务器将Codex连接到其知识库，已有数千名客户使用，并使用Daybreak进行安全。CEO Daksh Gupta表示，团队跟踪AI生成代码被回滚的频率，以此衡量为智能体提供上下文的价值。

news.title: Working with academic communities to build scientific understanding
news.summary: OpenAI公布了数学、计算机科学和物理学的三项新成果，并采用了由外部专家指导人建议的三种不同发布策略：原样发布数学输出，组建外部小组在发布输出的同时解释计算机科学结果，以及听从物理学小组的决定，在撰写结果时暂不公开AI产物。计算机科学小组立即将自然语言证明和Lean形式化发布到OpenAI的GitHub仓库，合作遵循四项原则：透明、不给予学术署名、认可和独立。

news.title: GPT-6.1 Sol helps CodeRabbit strengthen security across complex codebases
news.summary: CodeRabbit在其安全智能体中使用GPT-6.1 Sol作为主要模型，跨文件和组件分析pull request，Deep Scan覆盖依赖项，CodeRabbit Secure将调查扩展到链接的仓库，例如共享身份验证库。对于用户选定的发现，它可以在隔离的沙箱中尝试漏洞验证，并起草一个包含拟议修复的pull request供人工审查；CodeRabbit报告在数千个仓库和组织中标记了安全问题。

news.title: ChatGPT’s expanding world of work
news.summary: OpenAI经济研究发布了OpenAI Signals数据，覆盖近100个国家的165种工作活动，基于O*NET映射到中间工作活动，并按季度从2025年Q1到2026年Q3报告。在每季度观察的74个国家中，十大最常见活动在2026年Q3平均占每个国家分类工作消息的51.1%，低于2025年Q1的56.0%；该数据涵盖个人ChatGPT方案，不包括企业消息和Codex使用。

news.title: Our newest AI Quest: Mapping the human brain
news.summary: Google Research和斯坦福学习加速器推出了“Polar Peaks”，这是AI Quests系列中的第三个任务，教11至14岁的学生使用AI绘制神经元，任务包括数据清理和模型测试，灵感来自连接组学研究，包括完整果蝇大脑的绘制。迄今已有超过400,000个任务完成，本地化为10种语言，教师培训模块将在Google AI Educator Series中推出，Quest #3模块下个月上线；该项目在2026年获得AI教育、学习与培训类Webby奖，并在ETIH创新奖中获得最佳全球K-12学习解决方案奖。

news.title: How NVIDIA Minerva Turns Telemetry Chaos Into Peak GPU Yield
news.summary: NVIDIA Minerva是一个AI原生的AIOps平台，将GPU、网络、存储和工作负载的遥测统一到一个动态知识图谱中，将基础设施映射到活跃作业，使用监督和无监督模型检测灰障，例如400,000个NVLink接口中一个降级的接口，或相同负载下温度高于同类的GPU。拓扑感知关联将暂停帧风暴中的81条警报归为一个事件，估计节省了54小时的集群正常运行时间，一个名为Sherlock的AI智能体加上一个MCP服务器让操作员用自然语言查询实时证据。

news.title: How NVIDIA Mission Control 2.5 Brings Autonomous Recovery to Kubernetes
